svg.title: The foundation holds; the thirteen findings are in the shell around it
svg.text: Nothing underneath fails. What blocks is around it.
scans bounded by a scope file
images by digest, an offline bundle
verified by probes, never a model
who may act: one owner, no roles
its own crypto in no validated module
plain HTTP to the page and the models
no SBOM or signature of itself
a model's fact unlabelled in the CBOM
the inventory handled as plain files
IR 8547 final not in the packs
read 2026-11-06 at f3f2621; P0 blocks an authorization as it stands, P1 an assessor opens at once
